messages.subject: seek assistance in defining simple model
parts:
Hi lavaan users!

I am new to lavaan and to be honest my experience in such issues is minimum. For now I struggle to understand the syntax.
But i want to start,  I have a simple model and was wondering if somebody can help me to define it in lavaan.

So i have a database with SSY (specific sediment yield - this is the independent variable (tones/km2/year) and 3 explanatory variables. These are R (rainfall in mm), Sl (Slope of the basin in %)
and Fl, percentage Flysch in the basin (Flysch is here synonymous with easily eroded ground).

My model is in two stages. Firstly i use Rain and Slope and take SSY from R&Sl predictions based on these 2 vars.

Secondly i want to explain the residuals of the first regression (SSY - SSY from R&Sl) with Fl.

This i want to try with
A. Using Fl as factor (flysch - no flysch basins)
B. Using Fl as continuous var (% Fl in the basin)
C.  try a square term (Fl + Fl^2)

Can somebody help? 

And some additional questions:
-Can we use no intercept formulas in regressions [like lm(SSY =-1+ Sl +R)]
-How can we use a subset of the dataset (exclude an outlier)

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: seek assistance in defining simple model
parts:
Karalis,
Something like this?


require(lavaan)

simulation_model <- '
  # Phantom variable
  SSY_residual =~ 0
 
  # Explanatory Equations
  SSY ~ 10 + .5*R + .5*SI + 1*SSY_residual
  SSY_residual ~ 0 + .5 * FI_percent
 
  # Disturbances
  SSY~~0*SSY
  SSY_residual~~1*SSY_residual
 
  # Exogenous variances and covariances
  FI_percent~~.5*FI_percent
  R~~1*R
  SI~~1*SI
  FI_percent~~.1*R
  FI_percent~~.1*SI
  R~~.1*SI'

my_data <- simulateData(simulation_model)
FI_dichotomous <- as.numeric(my_data$FI_percent > mean(my_data$FI_percent))
FI_percent_square <- my_data$FI_percent^2
my_data <- data.frame(my_data, FI_dichotomous, FI_percent_square)
round(cov(my_data),3)
summary(my_data)

fit_model <- '
  # Phantom variable
  SSY_residual =~ 0
 
  # Explanatory Equations
  SSY ~ 1 + R + SI + 1*SSY_residual
  SSY_residual ~ 0*1 + FI_dichotomous + FI_percent + FI_percent_square
 
  # Disturbances
  SSY~~0*SSY
  SSY_residual~~SSY_residual'

my_fit <- lavaan(fit_model, data=my_data)
summary(my_fit)
